prompt: We're building an alerts module for webhook notification channels. I've written the routes, service, and repository — can you do a quick architecture check and let me know if anything violates our onion-architecture rules?

assertions.name: flags-cross-module-import
assertions.description: Flags that service.ts imports from ../repos/constants.ts (cross-module import)

assertions.name: flags-service-bypasses-repo
assertions.description: Flags that service.ts queries container.db directly instead of using the repository

assertions.name: suggests-repo-delegation
assertions.description: Recommends moving the duplicate-check query into the repository
